  - [OB-uit-runtime-budget] The winding probes have up to ~10^4 tetrahedra before simplification; exact TV at r = 4 may not finish; slices follow tv

  - [OB-uit-truncation] Every cancellation and residual statement is at a stated truncation (n <= N_max, SL(2,Z) word length, class list, bounda
